keyPoints: Anupat (ratio) do rashiyon ki tulna hai — 3:5 padhte hain teen anupat paanch; dono rashiyon ki ikai same honi chahiye.
Anupat ko saraltam roop me likho: 20:30 = 2:3 — dono pakshon ko unke HCF se bhaag do.
Samanupat (proportion) me chaar rashiyan is kram me hoti hain ki pehle ka doosre se wahi anupat ho jo teesre ka chauthe se — 2:4 :: 3:6.
Samanupat me bahari padon ka guna madhya padon ke guna ke barabar hota hai: a:b :: c:d me a x d = b x c.
Aikik niyam (unitary method) me pehle ek ikai ka maan nikaalo, phir maangi hui sankhya ka — 5 pen 75 rupaye to 1 pen 15 rupaye, 8 pen 120 rupaye.
Anupat se hisse baant-te hain — 2:3 me 500 rupaye baantne par pehle ko 200, doosre ko 300 milenge.
Aam galti: alag ikai wali rashiyon ka anupat banana — 1 metre aur 50 cm ka anupat 1:50 nahi, 100:50 = 2:1 hai.
subject: Maths
title: Anupat aur Samanupat
